Giving an honest review, My experience with Visas Avenue has been good. On a scale of 10 I will rate them 6.

I started my journey with them around the end of December 2017. I was referred by a friend who had a great experience (probably because my friend's case and profile was different and stronger). But, however visa applications differ from case to case and mine wasn't as strong. So, definitely my case needed more attention.

However, speaking about the Mumbai team of VA, they will show you a lot of dreams and also their assessment gets too fabricated where as in reality it's nothing close to what they assess and after enrolling with them I realized I would have achieved my goal faster had I applied for a Student Visa as compared to the Permanent Residence Visa. But, once enrolled there is no going back.

The Delhi Team however was better as they were didn't give false hopes but yes at times the evaluation team that checks your documents they mess up. One of the goof up was made in my documents but I was lucky enough to get a chance to re-submit my documents.

My Case Officer Mr. Amit Kumar Gautam has been very helpful throughout. He always made sure to get my doubts cleared and even if he wasn't aware of anything then he always got back to me after researching about the query and cleared it.

Overall, the Delhi team definitely needs well informed agents as more than their agents it is the client who holds better and more information and they need to understand that the client is paying a bomb amount so they need to provide the client with better information instead of it being the other way round.

In the end, I will definitely recommend Visas Avenue to my friends and colleagues but also would ask them to be behind their respective agents as many times they get laid back and leave your files if there is no progress happening on it. They just require a push at times and then they help you with everything.

Also, we need to understand that the agents are responsible in guiding us through the process and not responsible for us receiving our Visas.

featured_reviews.name: Shrungal Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent student visa appointment at VFS Global's German Consulate in Mumbai was a very smooth experience, thanks to a few factors. I had booked a slot for the Premium Lounge, and if you can afford the extra cost, it's absolutely the best choice.
I arrived well before my scheduled appointment time of 12 PM, and because there was very little rush, the entire process was completed much faster than I anticipated. The efficiency of the premium lounge staff was a major factor. The lounge has a dedicated team to guide you through every single step, from document verification to biometrics.
The key benefit of the Premium Lounge is the convenience. If any documents are missing, you can print them right there without leaving the premises. This alone saves a significant amount of stress and time. They also offer services like on-site biometric photo capture, which is incredibly helpful.
While the normal queue can be fast if you're lucky and there's no rush, the premium lounge guarantees a swift and guided experience. And for the little things that make a difference, the lounge offers complimentary tea, coffee, cookies, and a section with sweets and salted chips. While it's impossible to "cover the cost" of the lounge just by eating snacks—as a friend of mine proved by eating 30 chocolates and still barely making a dent—they are a nice touch that adds to the overall convenience and comfort.
One important note for those driving: There is parking available, but it is paid and can be a downside. The cost starts at ₹300 for the first two hours. If you exceed that by even a minute, an additional ₹100 is added, which can quickly add up.
Overall, the VFS Global German Consulate in Mumbai offers a fantastic service. If you're on a tight schedule or just want peace of mind, the premium lounge is a worthwhile investment, just be mindful of the parking fees.

Understanding Your UK Visa Refusal Letter

A UK visa refusal letter explains why your application was refused and outlines any available options, including Administrative Review, Appeal, Judicial Review or submitting a new application. Understanding these reasons before taking action can help you decide the most appropriate next step.

Read our complete guide.

UK Visa Sponsorship for Skilled Worker Visa

Planning to work in the UK? A Skilled Worker Visa requires a genuine job offer from a UK employer that holds a valid Sponsor Licence and has assigned you a Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS).

At The SmartMove2UK, we help you understand the sponsorship process, verify your supporting documents, and prepare a strong Skilled Worker Visa application. Our experienced immigration professionals provide guidance at every stage—from document review to application submission.

Please note: SmartMove2UK does not provide or sell Certificates of Sponsorship (CoS). We assist eligible applicants with the visa process once they have secured a genuine sponsorship from a licensed UK employer.

Book your consultation today and move forward with confidence.

Left out a document in your UK Visa Application? Here’s what you need to do!

Did you know that the Home Office can automatically refuse your UK visa application if even just one document is missing?

Once you submit your biometrics, you cannot add any more documents. The decision will be made strictly on the evidence already submitted.

Top 5 most common missing documents include:
1️⃣ Bank statements
2️⃣ TB certificates
3️⃣ Sponsor letters/references
4️⃣ Documents not translated or certified
5️⃣ Missing marriage/family paperwork

How to fix it: Contact your Visa Application Centre (VAC) before your biometrics appointment. Many offer a paid scanning service to add missing documents! If your application is already refused, you might need to resubmit or apply for an Administrative Review.

Don't risk a refusal! Get the full details in our latest 2026 guide.

Planning a move to the UK? Know your visa processing times!

Timing your application correctly is key to a smooth relocation or travel experience. As of recent UKVI updates, standard processing times for applications made from outside the UK are:

✅ Visitor Visas: 3 weeks (15 working days)
✅ Student Visas: 3 weeks (15 working days)
✅ Skilled Worker Visas: 3 weeks (15 working days)
✅ Spouse / Partner Visas: 12 weeks

Need an urgent decision? You can opt for Priority Service (5 working days) or Super Priority Service (next working day) for eligible visa routes.

Even minor mistakes in your documentation can result in lengthy delays or sudden visa refusals. Ensure your application is accurate and decision-ready the first time around.

At The SmartMove2UK, our experienced immigration legal team assists applicants across Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, and Chandigarh to secure their UK visas seamlessly.

📖 Read our complete, up-to-date guide or get in touch with our experts to start your application!

UK Tourist Visa Rejection Reasons in 2026

Many UK visitor visa refusals occur because of weak financial evidence, unclear travel purpose, credibility concerns, missing supporting documents, or selecting the wrong visitor category. Applicants should ensure that their documents, travel plans, and financial evidence all support the purpose of their trip.

Learn the most common refusal reasons and discover practical ways to strengthen your application.

Read the full guide.

The UK Journey Timeline

Many people focus on obtaining a UK visa.

However, for many applicants, that is only the beginning.

A long-term immigration journey may include:

• Visa Application

• Arrival in the UK

• Visa Extension

• Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR)

• British Citizenship

Understanding your long-term goals can help shape the decisions you make today.

Speak with The SmartMove2UK about your UK immigration plans.

How to Check if Your UK Visa Is Approved or Rejected

Waiting for a UK visa decision can create uncertainty, especially when receiving multiple updates from different sources.

Official communication from UK Visas and Immigration is generally the most reliable way to understand whether a decision has been made. Applicants may also receive passport collection or dispatch updates, but these do not always indicate the final outcome.

Could You Be Refused Before You Even Apply?

Many UK visa refusals begin long before the application reaches the decision stage.

Common issues include:

• Incorrect documentation

• Inconsistent information

• Financial evidence problems

• Poor application planning

• Choosing the wrong visa category

Virat Kohli's decision to play county cricket in England highlighted how elite athletes can benefit from valuable sporting experience while meeting UK immigration requirements.
